rules.VALID: Shared-scale and explicit-map evidence are compatible, or exactly one governed valid route applies and the other is absent.
rules.INVALID: A governed map is present and fails while no valid shared-scale route applies.
rules.UNDEFINED: Neither route is governed sufficiently to decide.
rules.INCONSISTENT: Shared-scale evidence and explicit threshold-map evidence conflict.
